Hagerstown Sept 27th
For Adam Fair view six a
M twenty seventh there is no
change of the position of the
enemy about Martinsburg the RR bridge
across the Opequan two miles east
from Martinsbg was fired yesterday the
Railroad bridge over buck Creek has
been destroyed they have a heavy
Rebel force at Cherry run on
the Potomac . no force of the 
enemy this side of Hancock on
the Md side signed W W
